context.description: Slug of the bounded context whose vocabulary this is. A glossary sits beside a service, and the words in it belong to the context that service is in, so shop/oms/GLOSSARY.md is read as shop. Left out, the name of the input directory.

files.description: The glossaries to read, as globs relative to the input root. Left out, GLOSSARY.md at the root of it.

out.description: Name of the fragment file, inside the step's output directory. Left out, glossary.json.
